digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and file-impact scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral and contributes no paths without poisoning sibling declarations, unlike undeclared children
A live undeclared child poisons child inheritance and blocks all-none promotion, while closed children are always ignored

Container scope must follow exact precedence: own/cited/inherited dependency paths → explicit parent `none` → all-live-children-none promotion (only if no undeclared live children) → otherwise `unscoped`
P9 must pass leaves and containers with all live children authenticated, advising only live undeclared poisoners with both path declaration and `--none` remedies
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
Mixed scope signatures must survive unrelated file drift but become stale when declared child paths change
